cipher.name: KeyboardRowShiftLeftWithCasePreservation
cipher.idea: Shift every letter (both consonants and vowels) to its immediate left neighbor on a standard QWERTY keyboard row, wrapping around to the end of the same row. Case is preserved, and non-alphabetic characters remain completely unchanged. This utilizes the highly effective keyboard-shift family but shifts left to provide a fresh mapping that maintains high reasoning scores.
cipher.encrypt_rules:
For each character in the input text:
1. Identify if the character is an alphabetic letter.
2. If it is not a letter, leave it unchanged.
3. If it is a letter, find its row on a standard QWERTY keyboard:
   - Row 1: q w e r t y u i o p (and uppercase Q W E R T Y U I O P)
   - Row 2: a s d f g h j k l (and uppercase A S D F G H J K L)
   - Row 3: z x c v b n m (and uppercase Z X C V B N M)
4. Shift the letter to its immediate left neighbor in that row. If it is the first letter of the row, wrap around to the last letter of the same row:
   - Row 1: q->p, w->q, e->w, r->e, t->r, y->t, u->y, i->u, o->i, p->o
   - Row 2: a->l, s->a, d->s, f->d, g->f, h->g, j->h, k->j, l->k
   - Row 3: z->m, x->z, c->x, v->c, b->v, n->b, m->n
5. Preserve the original case (uppercase maps to uppercase, lowercase to lowercase).
cipher.decrypt_rules:
For each character in the input text:
1. Identify if the character is an alphabetic letter.
2. If it is not a letter, leave it unchanged.
3. If it is a letter, find its row on a standard QWERTY keyboard:
   - Row 1: q w e r t y u i o p (and uppercase Q W E R T Y U I O P)
   - Row 2: a s d f g h j k l (and uppercase A S D F G H J K L)
   - Row 3: z x c v b n m (and uppercase Z X C V B N M)
4. Shift the letter to its immediate right neighbor in that row. If it is the last letter of the row, wrap around to the first letter of the same row:
   - Row 1: p->q, q->w, w->e, e->r, r->t, t->y, y->u, u->i, i->o, o->p
   - Row 2: l->a, a->s, s->d, d->f, f->g, g->h, h->j, j->k, k->l
   - Row 3: m->z, z->x, x->c, c->v, v->b, b->n, n->m
5. Preserve the original case (uppercase maps to uppercase, lowercase to lowercase).

example.plaintext: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
